title: Transition Configuration File
description: Defines successor authorities, predecessor assignments, and vesting date.

vestingDate.description: ISO date when successor authorities come into existence (e.g. '2027-04-01')

name.description: Name of the successor unitary authority

fullPredecessors.description: Councils whose entire estate transfers to this successor

partialPredecessors.description: Councils whose estate is split across multiple successors
